records.jp: どうしたの？<CR>こんなとこに呼び出して
records.en_original: Why'd you guys call me here? Is something wrong?
records.en: What is wrong?<CR>Calling me out to a place like this.

records.jp: いつも戦闘お疲れ様。<CR>おまけにリーダーもしてくれてるし、毎日大変だよね
records.en_original: We wanted to thank you for everything you do for us. We know it's exhausting have to fight and be our leader.
records.en: Thanks for all your hard work fighting every day.<CR>And you serve as our leader too, so every day must be difficult.

records.jp: 私たち、何かお返ししたいなって思って<CR>料理班にお願いして作業室借りたんだ
records.en_original: We thought we'd do something for you in return, so we borrowed this room from the Cooking Team for the day.
records.en: We wanted to do something for you in return,<CR>so we asked the cooking team to lend us the workroom.

records.jp: こころー？　もうできたー？
records.en_original: Is it ready, Kokoro?
records.en: Kokoro? Is it ready?

records.jp: うん、ばっちりだよ
records.en_original: Yup! All done!
records.en: Yes. It is perfect!

records.jp: え、なになに？
records.en_original: Ooh! What is it?
records.en: Huh? What is it?

records.jp: じゃーん！<CR>うちら特製の愛央いたわり鍋でーす！
records.en_original: Ta-da! It's our special, homemade We Love Ao Hot Pot!!
records.en: Ta-da!<CR>It is our special Ao Appreciation Hot Pot!

records.jp: マジ！？<CR>めっちゃ美味しそうなんだけど！
records.en_original: No way! This looks amazing!
records.en: Seriously!?<CR>It looks incredibly delicious!

records.jp: （ん？　夏に鍋？）
records.en_original: (Hm? Hot pot in summer?)
records.en: (Hm? Hot pot in summer?)

records.jp: （ま、別にいっか。<CR>いつ食べても美味しいし）
records.en_original: (I guess it doesn't matter. Hot pot is good in any season.)
records.en: (Well, I guess it does not matter.<CR>Hot pot is delicious whenever you eat it.)

records.jp: 早速食べちゃっていい？<CR>もうお腹ペコペコでさぁ……
records.en_original: Can I dig in? I'm already starving...
records.en: Can I start eating right away?<CR>I am already starving...

records.jp: ただで出すと思ってるのか？
records.en_original: You thought it would be that easy?
records.en: Did you think we would serve it for free?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: きららたちだぞ
records.en_original: You must not know us very well.
records.en: This is Kirara and the others we are talking about.

records.jp: まさか……
records.en_original: No way...
records.en: Do not tell me...

records.jp: この中から、愛央が一番信頼できる者を選ぶのだ。<CR>その者に“最後のひと手間”を加えてもらう
records.en_original: You must choose the one person you trust the most. That person will add the final touch.
records.en: Choose the person you trust most from among us.<CR>That person will add the "finishing touch."

records.jp: いい、いい！　そういうのいいから！<CR>今のままで充分美味しそうだから！
records.en_original: What? But it looks so yummy already!
records.en: No, no! We do not need anything like that!<CR>It already looks delicious enough as it is!

records.jp: そういうわけにはいかない。<CR>遊び心を忘れたら、きららたちが作る意味がない
records.en_original: It doesn't work that way. What's the point if we don't have a little fun.
records.en: That will not do.<CR>If we forget our playful spirit, there is no point in Kirara and the others making it.

records.jp: ええ～……
records.en_original: Aww...
records.en: Ehh...

records.jp: なお、我々はお互いがどんな食材を持ってきたのか<CR>知らない
records.en_original: We also have no idea what kind of ingredients the others brought.
records.en: For the record, none of us knows<CR>what ingredients the others brought.

records.jp: マジかよ……
records.en_original: Seriously...?
records.en: Seriously...?

records.jp: （こんな闇鍋の亜種みたいな……<CR>ああ、だから夏に鍋することになったのかな）
records.en_original: (Just like one of those mystery hot pots they do on TV... That explains why we're having it in summer.)
records.en: (This is like some variant of a mystery hot pot...<CR>Ah, is that why we ended up having hot pot in summer?)

records.jp: （仕方ない。覚悟決めよう）
records.en_original: (Guess I'll have to choose someone.)
records.en: (It cannot be helped. I will brace myself and choose.)

records.jp: きららで
records.en_original: I choose Kirara.
records.en: I choose Kirara.

records.jp: ほう。して、その理由は？
records.en_original: Interesting. May I ask why you chose me?
records.en: Oh? And your reason?

records.jp: なんやかんやで美味しいの選んでくれそうだから
records.en_original: I have a feeling that you picked something good.
records.en: Because somehow, I feel like you will choose something tasty.

records.jp: ふーん。ふふっ
records.en_original: Hmm... Heheh.
records.en: Hmm. Heheh.

records.jp: それ、どっちの笑み？
records.en_original: What's that supposed to mean?
records.en: What kind of smile is that?

records.jp: いただきまーす
records.en_original: Let's eat!
records.en: Thanks for the food!

records.jp: ん？何これ……パリパリする
records.en_original: Hm? What's this crunch I'm getting.
records.en: Hm? What is this...? It is crunchy.

records.jp: ラーメン菓子だ
records.en_original: Ramen snacks.
records.en: Ramen snacks.

records.jp: あ、意外といける。<CR>クリスピーな感じで
records.en_original: This is actually pretty good. It's nice and crispy.
records.en: Oh, this is surprisingly good.<CR>It adds a crispy texture.

records.jp: ラーメンが締めにいけるなら<CR>先に入れてもよかろう
records.en_original: People put noodles in at the end of a hot pot sometimes. I thought why not try putting it in at the beginning?
records.en: If ramen works as the finishing course,<CR>then there is no reason not to put it in first.

records.jp: だいぶ見た目違うけどね。<CR>でも、きらら信用してよかった
records.en_original: Definitely doesn't look like any hot pot I've ever seen. Still, I'm glad I trusted you, Kirara.
records.en: It looks rather different, though.<CR>Still, I am glad I trusted you, Kirara.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんで
records.en_original: Hiori, then.
records.en: I will go with Hiori-san.

records.jp: はーい！<CR>任せて任せて！
records.en_original: Okaaaaay! Leave it to me!
records.en: Okaaay!<CR>Leave it to me!

records.jp: きっと美味しくなると思うから<CR>……多分
records.en_original: This is gonna taste amazing. ...I hope.
records.en: I am sure it will make it delicious.<CR>...Probably.

records.jp: 嫌な予感する言葉聞こえたんだけど
records.en_original: C-could you say that last part again?
records.en: I heard a phrase that gives me a bad feeling.

records.jp: いただきまーす
records.en_original: Let's eat...!
records.en: Thanks for the food!

records.jp: あっふ！　えっ、ちょっ……あっつ！
records.en_original: HOT! Mmph... HOT!
records.en: H-hot! Wait, wha... hot!

records.jp: 何これ？　たこ焼き？
records.en_original: What is this? Takoyaki?
records.en: What is this? Takoyaki?

records.jp: うん。出汁入ってるし、合うかなと思って
records.en_original: Bingo! It's made with the same fish stock, so I thought it might go well with hot pot!
records.en: Yeah. It has dashi in it too, so I thought it might go well.

records.jp: 合うっちゃ合うけど、中めっちゃ熱いんだけど。<CR>火の玉でも入ってるかと思った
records.en_original: It's good, but it's crazy hot. I thought you put hot coals in or something.
records.en: It does go together, but the inside is insanely hot.<CR>I thought you had put a fireball in there.

records.jp: えー、そんなまさか
records.en_original: Aw, you're exaggerating.
records.en: Ehh, no way.

records.jp: 食べてみてよ。<CR>私ももう一口もらうから
records.en_original: Try it! I'll have another bite too.
records.en: Try it.<CR>I will have another one too.

records.jp: あっつー！　<CR>でも美味しー！
records.en_original: So hot! But it's good!
records.en: Hoooot!<CR>But delicious!

records.jp: 何がしたいんだあの二人は
records.en_original: What's with those two?
records.en: What are those two trying to do?

records.jp: 勇希で
records.en_original: Yuki, then.
records.en: I will choose Yuki.

records.jp: え、あたし？<CR>やー、照れちゃうなぁ
records.en_original: Whaat? Me? I knew nothing could stop our love.
records.en: Huh, me?<CR>Aw, you are making me blush.

records.jp: じゃあ、期待には応えなくちゃね！
records.en_original: All right, hope you enjoy it!
records.en: Then I have to live up to your expectations!

records.jp: （あ、もしかして人選ミスった？）
records.en_original: (Oh no... Did I choose the wrong person?)
records.en: (Uh-oh, did I choose the wrong person?)

records.jp: いただきまーす
records.en_original: Let's eat!
records.en: Thanks for the food!

records.jp: うっ！
records.en_original: Ugh!
records.en: Ugh!

records.jp: 勇希……何入れた……？<CR>鍋からしちゃいけない味がする
records.en_original: Yuki... What did you add...? Hot pot shouldn't taste like this.
records.en: Yuki... what did you put in it...?<CR>It tastes like something no hot pot ever should.

records.jp: えー？　ちょっと清涼感を足しただけだよ？
records.en_original: Huh? I just added a nice refreshing dash of something.
records.en: Huh? I only added a little refreshing sensation.

records.jp: 清涼感？
records.en_original: A refreshing dash?
records.en: A refreshing sensation?

records.jp: ガム、入れさせていただきましたっ
records.en_original: Chewing gum!
records.en: I took the liberty of adding chewing gum!

records.jp: 何してんだあんたはー！！
records.en_original: What is wrong with you?!
records.en: What are you doing!?

records.jp: あれ？　言ったんだけどなぁ
records.en_original: Huh? I thought I told her.
records.en: Huh? I am sure I told you.

records.jp: 好きなものを入れるのはいいけど、<CR>食べ物を粗末にするようなことはしないでねって
records.en_original: You can add anything you want, just as long as it doesn't make it taste bad.
records.en: It is fine to add something you like, but<CR>do not do anything that wastes food.

records.jp: あ、ご祈祷の時間だった。帰ろっと
records.en_original: Oh look, it's time for my daily prayers. I'll be heading home.
records.en: Oh, it is time for prayers. I am heading back.

records.jp: わ、私もー
records.en_original: M-me too!
records.en: M-me too!

records.jp: ここは安牌のこころで
records.en_original: I bet Kokoro chose something good.
records.en: I will play it safe and choose Kokoro.

records.jp: ありがとう、信用してくれて
records.en_original: Thanks for trusting me.
records.en: Thank you for trusting me.

records.jp: 絶対美味しいお鍋にするから！
records.en_original: You're going to love this hot pot!
records.en: I will make it absolutely delicious!

records.jp: 頼もしいな……
records.en_original: My hero...
records.en: That is reassuring...

records.jp: いただきまーす
records.en_original: Let's eat!
records.en: Thanks for the food!

records.jp: うわ、このお肉すごく美味しい。<CR>なんのお肉？
records.en_original: Wow, this meat is so tasty! What is it?
records.en: Wow, this meat is really delicious.<CR>What kind of meat is it?

records.jp: 鹿……っぽいもの
records.en_original: Venison... I think.
records.en: Something... deer-like.

records.jp: 「ぽい」ってどういうこと？<CR>それにどうやって手に入れ……
records.en_original: What you mean, you think? Where did you get it anyway?
records.en: What does "deer-like" mean?<CR>And how did you get it...?

records.jp: よかったぁ。愛央ちゃんの口に合って
records.en_original: I'm glad you like it Ao.
records.en: I am glad it suits your taste, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ねぇ、どうやって……
records.en_original: Wh-where did you find it though...?
records.en: Hey, how did you...?

records.jp: （やめよう。<CR>この世には知らなくていいこともある）
records.en_original: (Never mind. Some questions are best left unanswered.)
records.en: (Let us stop.<CR>There are some things in this world better left unknown.)
